mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect partly cloudy skies with temperatures around 68 degrees near Harriet Park. Since it is a New Moon, the night sky is extra dark, perfect for spotting the International Space Station tonight at 8:19 PM. It will rise over Mount Horeb and travel toward the Madison area, eventually passing almost directly overhead for six minutes.

City updates include the start of bridge construction on the Military Ridge State Trail, which will be closed between Lincoln and South Franklin Streets until mid-November. Also, the police department is looking for applicants for their upcoming nine-week Citizen Academy, a free program that starts September 23.

There is plenty to do in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today, while Hop Haus is hosting trivia this evening. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmers Market on the Square this Saturday.
Regarding the weekly police report, officers initiated an investigation on Sunday, August 30, into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that allegedly occurred in 2019.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10 PM. Stop by to enjoy today's flavor, which is Dark Chocolate Decadence.
